messages:
Carla Gomez: Quick heads-up — smoke prober started returning intermittent 504s for opt-quant-6144 v2 during ingest. Seen on ~3 models in the last 2 runs. Anyone else?
Ben Patel: Seen similar on a TPU-run. Logs show `RuntimeError: unsupported kernel int8_matmul` then timeout. Probably operator fallback causing big slowdown.
onboard-bot: ingest job 23100055 — prober step failed (timeout) — model: opt-quant-6144-v2 — run 2026-03-19T17:32Z
Dmitri Ivanov: If prober runs full E2E generation at 1k tokens, quantized models may exceed our latency SLO and get killed. We should separate 'interop' (ops/warmup) from 'perf' (long gen).
Eva Liu: Agreed. Tradeoff: stricter prober catches runtime incompatibilities earlier but increases time-to-admit. We could do a lightweight op-prober that just runs a few operator kernels + KV cache smoke.
Carla Gomez: +1. Proposal: do fast-op probe (10-20ms kernels, shape checks) synchronously, and queue full perf probe async in staging with canary traffic for 24h. If perf probe fails, roll back to prior model variant and alert.
Ben Patel: Sounds good. Also add a tolerant OOM/unsupported-op path: return 'needs-compat-shim' instead of hard fail, and record to registry.
Maeve: Need to update onboarding docs and UI states: admitted / pending-perf / needs-shim / rejected. Product ok with pending-perf for enterprise customers.
Dmitri Ivanov: Implementation sketch:
```
POST /internal/prober/opcheck
{ "model": "opt-quant-6144-v2", "checks": ["matmul_int8", "softmax"] }
# returns { status: "ok" | "needs-shim" | "blocked", details: "..." }
```
Carla Gomez: Also add bench meta to model registry: perf_signature = { p50, p95, kv_cold_warm, mem_peak } (small JSON). That way runtime can pick a compatible kernel set.
Eva Liu: Question: how do we validate correctness across quantized variants? We need golden prompts and semantic-sim metrics, but that adds compute.
Ben Patel: For correctness we run a tiny eval set (10 prompts) and compute exact-match / embedding-sim threshold. If below threshold mark 'quality-risk' and require manual review.
Maeve: Action items: Ben -> open RFC PR for prober refactor (async-canary + op-prober) by Wed. Dmitri -> prototype op-prober endpoint + operator whitelist. Carla -> draft minimal test matrix + registry fields. Eva -> design onboarding state transitions in console. onboard-bot: will post job diffs into #eng-ml when jobs change.
Carla Gomez: Thanks — let's sync on Fri 10am if PR lands. :thumbsup:
